label_budget: 3-day target training (72h) is used only to fit per-cell parameters; this protocol also uses the official ~60-day DC validation labels to select strength. This is not a 72h-only pipeline. Existing test labels have already been seen in prior work; test scores are exploratory and must not change selections or protocol.
